title: Control Plane Store Snapshot File Outbox

loop.observation: The store snapshot and file outbox workflow exercised durability tests but did not publish machine-readable evidence for the recovered event and metric shape.
loop.hypothesis: A focused durability sidecar can replay a tiny assignment flow through the real store, snapshot, and outbox adapters without live infrastructure.
loop.execute: Create temporary file-backed snapshot/outbox stores, run assignment and poll flows, verify recovered history and metrics, then upload CI evidence.
loop.evaluate: The verifier fails on event ordering drift, snapshot recovery drift, outbox failure metric drift, stale generated docs, missing source anchors, or workflow evidence regression.
loop.retrospective: This closes the file snapshot/outbox workflow evidence gap while keeping DynamoDB, EventBridge, and live deployment evidence in separate gates.
